avis.titre: Suitable for sensitive skin and layering
avis.texte: Love the consistency, not too thick like the night cream and not too watery. Suitable to my sensitive skin even if layered with other serums/creams. No outbreaks whatsoever even with first use.
Sérum efectivo, merece el precio El transporte deja que desear, pero el producto bueno y el vendedor muy atento

avis.titre: My Holy Grail Brightening Serum — I Keep Repurchasing!
avis.texte: This serum is truly one of my all-time favorite skincare products. I have purchased this multiple times (I honestly lost count!), and I always come back to it. I’m currently using the jumbo size because I love it so much. I’ve noticed my skin looks brighter, more radiant, and healthier with consistent use. For me, it has made a beautiful difference in my overall complexion, and my under-eye area looks much improved. This is a product I will continue purchasing again and again. I genuinely love this product so much.
Very prompt delivery. My sensitive skin tolerates it well. But I only received it yesterday, so it’s too soon to tell if it actually works in removing the brown patches.

This is a pricey skin brightener. I was inspired to buy it because an "influencer" I know recommended it. I'm usually pretty resistant to that kind of thing, but this time I took the bait. I use it morning and light, as directed. Does it work dramatically? Not very much, but I'm convinced if I don't put on some kind of cream, serum, etc., my skin will go to pot. Maybe I'd look worse without my regimens. I'm 67 with evidence of sun exposure. I think it helps with lessening that. But the thing I like best is the fragrance and the lightness of it. It dries quickly, not oily, not sticky, and it has a subtle floral scent that is such a nice thing to smell on my hands. It's a luxury item and I'm afraid I'm hooked.
